sources.claim: All tasks share 12h to submit patches, inclusive of sandbox setup and exclusive of patch validation. Exact private implementation boundaries are not disclosed by this wording.
Fresh CLI source downloaded read-only; explicitly parses per-task eval settings then runs two published examples. That sample loop is not the hidden scoring controller.
Organizer description says about 120 hidden tasks split evenly. Exact N remains unknown; local 129 is development data.
Fresh HARNESS_README read via authenticated CLI, not hidden task contents. Section 7.1 documents inference keys, session timing and fixed scorer verification timeout.

fields.timeout_seconds: Supported per-command ceiling; actual execution clamps to current session remaining time with the documented minimum-floor behavior.
fields.max_time_minutes: Supported per-task Agent loop minutes; starts after sandbox preparation.
fields.max_tool_calls: Supported charged-tool count; excludes get_status and submit_patch.
fields.max_turns: Supported per-task model-turn cap; not a global clock.
fields.verification_timeout_seconds: Local EvalConfig/Starter Phase 2 setting; fixed 300 seconds on scorer, not a submission-controlled Stage 1 field.

source_caveat: Web search excerpts have their reported crawl age; fresh CLI sources and pinned official SDK are separately hashed. No third-party estimates, leaderboard reverse-engineering or hidden solution data are used.
